author: serenita_io
content:
With PR #630 merged, I updated the `produceBlockV4WithBid` PR as discussed on today's CL breakout - https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 .

Beacon nodes should use the bid supplied by the VC during block production, but if they have a good reason not to, they are free to override it.

The approach is not set in stone yet, if you have ideas on how to do this better, let me know.
